    Join us

    Set the pace

    At TCS, we believe that the future of technology is shaped by people. As we move towards becoming the world’s largest AI‑led technology services, we foster a culture built on long‑term trust, collective growth, and purposeful innovation—where individuals are empowered to learn continuously, collaborate globally, and create meaningful impact with integrity.

    Here, people develop future‑ready skills, grow holistically, and contribute to shaping a better tomorrow—for themselves and for the world.

    Our Culture

    Cultivating collaboration beyond work

    Our connect with our people go beyond the workplace to create a holistic lifestyle that promotes a culture of fitness and fun where all are welcome to be their authentic selves.

    Get a glimpse  about   Cultivating collaboration beyond work

    Your path to a better future

    Learn to grow Learn to grow

    Learn to grow

    We encourage learning-linked growth where we equip our associates to deliver innovative solutions, by providing them with opportunities to access and learn from the vast collective experience and resources that exist within TCS. Our people put in a total of 56 million learning hours cumulatively for an average of 96.4 learning hours per person to acquire 5.2 million competencies to remain at the cutting edge of change.

    Community Community

    Community

    We are at the heart of driving positive change in the communities connected to us. In FY '25 we committed 1,038 crores as CSR spend with 14.8 million beneficiaries. 146K+ TCSers volunteered 8.9 million hours to bring in lasting positive impact to people.

    Health and well being Health and well being

    Health and well being

    We prioritize our associates' health and mental wellbeing. Programs like Fit4life promote a fitness culture by encouraging participation in events like yoga sessions and marathons for a holistic health. In the past year, 116+ million Fit4lifers traversed 303,000 kms, and 125,000 took part in yoga.

    Inspiring workspaces Inspiring workspaces

    Inspiring workspaces

    Work alongside your peers in world-class facilities spread across more than 38 million sq. ft. area across India. Our offices have a sustainability focus and are made with you - the future changemaker in mind. 79% of the energy consumed in TCS offices come from renewable sources with 10.2 MWp of rooftop solar energy being generated in TCS campuses itself.

    Diversity Diversity

    Diversity

    We are an equal opportunity employer committed to making an inclusive and equitable workplace where you are welcome as you are. We have employees representing 152 nationalities, and 35.2% of our workforce is comprised of women. We have three generations, with millennials accounting for 89% of the workforce.

    Your path to a better future

    Sudeep Kunnumal

    Chief Human Resources Officer, Tata Consultancy Services

    We are on an exciting journey to be the world’s leading AI-driven technology services organization, led by a bold vision to unlock endless possibilities and empower talent. Our commitment to lead with empathy, resilience, and purpose enables us to create positive impact for our employees, customers, partners, and communities we live in.
